title: Late Submission and Illness Extensions
text: Students requesting illness extensions must provide medical evidence before the deadline. If a student becomes ill and needs extra time for an assignment, they should submit the required evidence before the deadline.

title: Password Recovery
text: Users who forget their password can reset it using the password recovery link. Follow the recovery instructions to restore login access to your account.

title: Assignment Submission
text: Students should upload their assignments and coursework through the learning portal. Check that the correct file has been uploaded before the submission deadline.

title: Contractor Remote Work Policy
text: Contractors can work remotely only if the signed contract permits it. Contractors should review their signed agreement before making remote work arrangements.

title: Printer Troubleshooting
text: If a printer produces blank pages, check the ink levels and run the printer cleaning utility. If the problem continues, inspect the printer settings and consult the troubleshooting guide.
